name: Winter Vacation
source:
This winter, you weren't expecting to spend your vacation at your Grandma's. With no internet or technology to keep you busy, you decided to explore the neighborhood but the ending to this vacation all depends on your choices.

[From [url=https://leiphory.itch.io/winter-vacation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今年冬天，你没想到会在奶奶家度过假期。由于没有互联网或技术让你忙碌，你决定探索附近地区，但这个假期的结束完全取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://leiphory.itch.io/winter-vacation]Itch.io[/url]]
